g.title: lld
g.text: petstore-messaging — shared JMS contract library (class design)

g.title: cluster_reuse
g.text: Fleet reuse seam (every service imports petstore-messaging:1.0.0)

g.title: MessagingConfig
g.text: ONE JMS config for the whole fleet — replaces per-service JmsConfig copies

g.title: Spring
g.text: Artemis broker :61616 provided by each service, not this lib

g.title: MessagePublisher
g.text: Transport-only: routes by Destination.topic(), stamps _type. No tx logic.

g.title: Destination
g.text: Kind is DATA not naming — publisher/factories read topic() to route

g.title: EventMeta
g.text: Envelope mixin embedded in every event (no generic wrapper)

g.title: Correlation
g.text: HTTP<->JMS trace bridge via SLF4J MDC (framework-free)

g.title: Destinations
g.text: The ONE place destination names live — no scattered literals

g.title: Producers
g.text: call MessagePublisher.publish(...) from their after-commit gateways
